stem: What is the most likely reason Layla decides against taking the geode home?

options.label: A
options.text: She cannot think of a way to make the rock useful.

options.label: B
options.text: She realizes that the rock should stay in its natural surroundings.

options.label: C
options.text: She is afraid of what others might say if she keeps it.

options.label: D
options.text: She is worried that Cooper will try to take it away from her.
